confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'The part you need is a new drain pump' and '90% of cases like this are just the pump itself'

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'replacement is the reliable fix' recommended before the sump hose was checked or the model identified

rationale: The assistant never recognised that 'FD 9409' is a production code, never asked for the E-Nr or a display code, and never discussed the model needed to buy the right pump. It started out sensibly, but the final turn concluded 'you need a new drain pump' with an invented '90%' statistic while the sump hose blockage was still open. The impeller check and the unplug advice were safe and useful. There was no escalation to an engineer and no advice to identify the model before buying.</br>
